title: Pokémon Fulldex
description: Fulldex: all your favourite Pokémon games in one launcher, in widescreen at 60 fps on PC, Mac, Steam Deck, Android, iPhone and Switch. DS: Black 2, White 2, Black, White, HeartGold, SoulSilver, Platinum, Diamond, Pearl. GBA: Emerald, Ruby, Sapphire, FireRed, LeafGreen, Ultra Violet. 3DS coming soon.
